source_instruction: i am looking for a 6x9 ft backgrounds for digital photography.
query: I spent last weekend helping my little cousin decorate her bedroom with glow-in-the-dark star stickers, and we accidentally stuck a whole sheet of them to the family cat before we noticed—she spent three hours hiding under the couch hissing at her own glowing paws. I also spent way too long scrolling recipes for sourdough discard pancakes this morning and burned the first two batches so bad the smoke alarm went off twice, and my roommate started leaving passive sticky notes about kitchen safety on the fridge. I heard the community center down the street is hosting a beginner digital photography workshop next month, and someone mentioned they’re setting up a 6x9 ft backdrop for the portrait station there, with all the gear and supplies for the whole session coming in right under a $120 total budget per person. I’ve also been told those kinds of setups translate really well to shooting underwater shots too, if you seal the equipment properly.
